three_js.description: Slow starfield depth effect with a faint wireframe globe in the background. Travel and exploration energy. Destination dots appear across the globe.

relationships: Day has many Activities and an Accommodation
Trip has a PackingList with PackingItems

Trip has TripMembers — for group travel
Activity has a location, time, cost, and booking reference
Note belongs to a Trip or Day — free text observations

layout.notes: On desktop, map and itinerary always visible simultaneously — never toggle between them. Day tabs are the primary navigation on all form factors once inside a trip.

avoid: Never show a trip without a cover photo — use a destination stock image as default, never blank
Never use a modal for activity creation — always full screen or bottom sheet with map
Never lock the itinerary to a fixed time grid — activities should be flexible, time is optional
Never auto-sort activities by time without user confirmation
Never show a currency amount without specifying which currency
Never collapse the day tabs — always show all days as horizontal scroll tabs
Never require an account before creating a trip — allow guest planning with prompt to save
enforce: Trip cover photo always full bleed — no white borders or card containers around hero
Day tabs always visible as horizontal scroll — never in a dropdown
Activity time is optional — never required to add an activity
Budget always shows remaining amount prominently — not just total
Map view always accessible from any day plan — one tap
Offline mode indicator when planning without connection
Group member changes sync in real time with conflict resolution
Packing list accessible from trip overview in one tap

empty_states.ui: Destination photography mosaic background. Message: 'Where are you going?' CTA: 'Plan a trip'. Secondary: 'Explore destinations for inspiration'.
Map view of destination centred. Message: 'Nothing planned for [Day]'. CTA: 'Add activity'. Nearby popular places shown as suggestions below.
Suitcase illustration. Message: 'Your packing list is empty'. CTA: 'Add items'. Secondary: 'Use a template'. Show category suggestions: Clothes, Toiletries, Documents, Tech.

loading_states.ui: Trip cards skeleton — cover photo placeholder full width, trip name and date skeleton below. 2-3 cards shimmer.
Activity timeline skeleton — time column left, activity card right. 3 activity skeletons. Map thumbnail skeleton if shown.
Place cards grid skeleton — image top 4:3, name and category below. 6 cards shimmer.

error_flows.ui: Activity card shows name and time from local data. Details section: 'Details unavailable'. Retry button. Map pin still shows location.

error_flows.trigger: Group sync conflict (two users edit same day simultaneously)
error_flows.ui: Conflict banner: '[Name] also made changes'. Show diff: their changes vs yours. Options: 'Keep mine', 'Keep theirs', 'See both'. Never silently overwrite.
Document card shows failed state with red icon. Retry button. Other documents unaffected. Local copy retained for retry.
Changes saved locally with 'Pending sync' indicator. Banner: 'Offline — changes will sync when connected'. No data loss.

edge_cases.ui: Day tabs still shown — just one tab. Consistent UI regardless of trip length.

edge_cases.case: Activity that spans midnight (late night event)
edge_cases.ui: Activity appears at end of Day 1 with 'Ends next day' label. Does not duplicate on Day 2.
Group member list paginated. Activity voting shows top 3 voters then '+N others'. Budget split calculator handles all members.
Trip marked as 'Completed'. Read-only mode offered. Journal and photo mode prominently surfaced. No 'Add activity' CTA — only 'Add journal entry'.
